It is the highest tier of shovel, having higher mining efficiency, attack damage, durability, and enchantability than a diamond shovel.
Netherite Spear: A netherite spear is a late-game variant of spear obtained by upgrading a diamond spear using a netherite ingot and netherite upgrade at a smithing table. It can be used to perform slow jab attacks or held forward to deal increasing damage based on how quickly the wielder is moving. It is the highest tier of spear, dealing more damage and having higher durability than a diamond spear, at the cost of lower attack speed.
Netherite Sword: A netherite sword is a late-game variant of sword obtained by upgrading a diamond sword using a netherite ingot and netherite upgrade at a smithing table. It is the highest tier of sword, dealing more damage than a diamond sword and having higher durability.
Netherite Upgrade: A netherite upgrade is a type of smithing template used in smithing tables to upgrade armor and tools from diamond to netherite. It is consumed when used, but can be duplicated using an existing template, netherrack, and diamonds.
New Thing Banner Pattern: A new thing banner pattern is a joke banner pattern from Java Edition 23w13a_or_b. It is used to customize banners with a symbol that is based on an orientation of the M from the Mojang logo, which resembles an abstraction of a crewmate from Among Us.
Obsidian Boat: The obsidian boat was a joke boat variant included in Java Edition 15w14a.
Ominous Bottle: An ominous bottle is an item that gives a player the Bad Omen effect for 100 minutes when drank, which can cause an ominous event to start.
Ominous Trial Key: An ominous trial key is a type of trial key that can only be obtained from ominous trial spawners. It is used to unlock an ominous vault and obtain its loot.
Orange Dye: Orange dye is one of the sixteen available dyes.
Painting: Paintings are decorative entities that hang on walls. They have many different variants with different sizes when placed, which are chosen based on both the available space and random chance.
Paper: Paper is an item crafted from sugar cane, required for crafting books, maps, cartography tables, firework rockets and banner patterns.
Phantom Membrane: Phantom membranes are items obtained from killing phantoms. They are used to repair elytra and brew potions of Slow Falling.
Photo: A photo is an item containing a picture taken with a camera.
Potato Eye: A potato eye is an item used to locate colosseums and ruined portatols (if used in the Overworld) in 24w14potato.
Potato Oil: Potato oil is a joke item added in 24w14potato.
Potato Oil (Potion): Potato oil is a joke potion that provides It's very slippery when used.
Potato Peeler: The potato peeler is a joke weapon added in 24w14potato.
Potato Peels: Potato peels are a joke item, added in 24w14potato. They come in 17 different variants: default peels, 15 colored ones (there are no white peels), and corrupted potato peels.
Potato of Knowledge: A potato of knowledge is a joke item, added in 24w14potato.
Potion: Potions are bottled consumable liquids that give effects for a certain amount of time when drunk. They are primarily obtained from brewing. Every potion is brewed starting from a water bottle, which is considered a type of potion that has no effects.
Potion of Caring: A potion of Caring is a joke potion from Java Edition 15w14a that provides Caring when used. It replaces the data value of both potions of Slowness and potions of Poison.
Potion of Luck: A potion of Luck is a potion that provides Luck when used.
Potion of Night Vision: A potion of Night Vision is a potion that provides Night Vision when used.
Potion of Regeneration: A potion of Regeneration is a potion that provides Regeneration when used.
Potion of Strength: A potion of Strength is a potion that provides Strength when used.
Potion of Swiftness: A potion of Swiftness is a potion that provides Speed when used.
Potion of Water Breathing: A potion of Water Breathing is a potion that provides Water Breathing when used.
Potion of Weakness: A potion of Weakness is a potion that provides Weakness when used.
Potion of the Turtle Master: A potion of the Turtle Master is a potion that provides Slowness and Resistance when used.
Pottery Sherd: Pottery sherds are items with 23 variants used to craft decorated pots with ornamental designs. Pottery sherds are found in trial chambers, suspicious sand, and suspicious gravel.
Powder Snow Bucket: A powder snow bucket is a bucket filled with powder snow, which is the only way to carry it as an item.
Prismarine Crystals: Prismarine crystals are items obtained by defeating guardians or elder guardians. They are used along with prismarine shards to craft sea lanterns.
Prismarine Shard: A prismarine shard is an item obtained by defeating guardians or elder guardians. It can be used to craft various prismarine blocks as well as sea lanterns.
Prize Pottery Sherd: A prize pottery sherd is a pottery sherd that depicts a gemstone. It can be found in desert pyramids.
Pufferfish (item): A pufferfish is a food item sourced from killed pufferfish. It is poisonous to players, but can be safely fed to dolphins, nautiluses and wolves. It is also a brewing ingredient for potions of Water Breathing.
Pumpkin Pie: Pumpkin pie is a food item that can be eaten by the player.
Pumpkin Seeds:
Pumpkin seeds are items obtained from pumpkins that can be used to grow pumpkin stems.
Pumpkin stems are plants grown on farmland that, over time, grow pumpkins on dirt, mud and moss blocks adjacent to them.
Punch (item): Punch is a joke item added in 26w14a.
Purple Dye: Purple dye is one of the sixteen available dyes. Crafting it is possible only with other dyes.
Quiver: The quiver was an item that existed from Java Edition Indev 0.31 20091231-2147 until Java Edition Indev 0.31 20100110. Like other items at the time, it was ultimately nonfunctional and only existed for testing purposes.
Rabbit's Foot: A rabbit's foot is a brewing and tempting item obtained from rabbits and camel husk husk riders.
Rabbit Hide: Rabbit hide is an item dropped by rabbits.
Rabbit Stew: Rabbit stew is a food item that can be eaten by the player.
Raiser Armor Trim: Raiser armor trim is a type of smithing template used in smithing tables to add a trim to armor. It is consumed when used, but can be duplicated using an existing template, terracotta, and diamonds.
Raw Beef: Raw beef is a food item that can be eaten by the player or cooked in a furnace, smoker, or campfire to make steak.
Raw Chicken: Raw chicken is a food item that can be eaten by the player. It can be cooked in a furnace, smoker, or a campfire to make cooked chicken.
Raw Cod: Raw cod is a food item that can be eaten by the player or cooked to make cooked cod.
Raw Copper: Raw copper is a raw metal resource obtained from mining copper ore.
Raw Gold: Raw gold is a raw metal resource obtained from mining gold ore.
Raw Iron: Raw Iron is an item obtained by mining iron ore. It can be smelted in a furnace or blast furnace to produce iron ingots, which are used in crafting and building.
Raw Mutton: Raw mutton is a food item dropped by sheep when killed.
Raw Porkchop: A raw porkchop is a food item that is dropped by pigs and hoglins and can be cooked into a cooked porkchop.
Raw Rabbit: Raw rabbit is a food item that can be eaten by the player, or cooked in a furnace or a campfire to make cooked rabbit.
Raw Salmon: Raw salmon is a food item that can be eaten by the player or cooked to make cooked salmon.
Reality Vision: The reality vision is a joke helmet in 1.RV-Pre1.
Recovery Compass: A recovery compass is an item that can be held by a player who has died to point to where their most recent death occurred, as long as they are in the same dimension. If these conditions are not met, it will spin in random directions.
Red Dye: Red dye is one of the sixteen available dyes.
Redstone Dust:
Redstone dust is a mineral used in crafting, brewing, trimming, and as a placeable wire.
Redstone wire is a non-solid block that can transmit a redstone power signal up to 15 blocks in distance; signal strengths below 15 have reduced distance. Redstone wire can power blocks it is placed on or pointing at.
Resin Brick: A resin brick is an item used to create resin bricks. It can also be used as a smithing ingredient, giving orange details to pieces of armor.
Resin Clump: A resin clump is a block generated by a creaking heart on pale oaks in any biome when a creaking is attacked. It also drops when a creaking heart is mined or destroyed. It can be used to craft decorative blocks of resin, and can also be smelted to produce resin bricks, which in turn can be crafted into the whole resin brick block family.
Rib Armor Trim: Rib armor trim is a type of smithing template used in smithing tables to add a trim to armor. It is consumed when used, but can be duplicated using an existing template, netherrack, and diamonds.
Rotten Flesh: Rotten flesh is a food item that can be eaten by players, but may inflict Hunger. It can also be safely fed to tamed wolves or sold to cleric villagers.
Ruby: Rubies were a mineral planned to be added in Java Edition 1.3.1 as a currency for trading with villagers, but were scrapped and replaced with emeralds.
Saddle: A saddle is equipment for certain animals that either enables or improves the act of riding them. All saddled animals can be directly controlled, except for pigs and striders, which must be guided using carrots or warped fungi on sticks.
Scrape Pottery Sherd: A scrape pottery sherd is a pottery sherd that depicts an axe. It can be found in trial chambers.
Sentry Armor Trim: Sentry armor trim is a type of smithing template used in smithing tables to add a trim to armor. It is consumed when used, but can be duplicated using an existing template, cobblestone, and diamonds.
Shaper Armor Trim: A shaper armor trim is a type of smithing template used in smithing tables to add a trim to armor. It is consumed when used, but can be duplicated using an existing template, terracotta, and diamonds.
Shazboots!: Shazboots! are a joke item added in 25w14craftmine. They appear identical to chainmail boots when worn, despite having a unique item texture.
Sheaf Pottery Sherd: A sheaf pottery sherd is a pottery sherd that depicts wheat. It can be found in trail ruins.
Shears: Shears are a tool crafted from iron ingots. They are required to obtain some organic blocks or otherwise mine them faster as well as to shear certain entities and blocks.
Shelter Pottery Sherd: A shelter pottery sherd is a pottery sherd that depicts an acacia tree. It can be found in the suspicious sand of warm ocean ruins.
Shield: A shield is a defensive tool that can be used to block damage from melee attacks, ranged attacks and explosions. Shields are temporarily disabled when hit by an axe or attacked by a warden while blocking, and certain damage sources ignore a shield's protection. Shields can have ornamental banner designs applied to them.
Shimmering Key: A shimmering key is an item added in 25w14craftmine in Java Edition.
Shovel: A shovel is a tiered tool that can quickly break sand, gravel, and dirt-related blocks. Shovels also have a unique interaction with dirt-related blocks, and can turn them into dirt paths.
Shulker Shell: Shulker shells are items dropped by shulkers that are used solely to craft shulker boxes.
Silence Armor Trim: Silence armor trim is a type of smithing template used in smithing tables to add a decorative trim to armor. It is consumed when used, but can be duplicated using an existing template, cobbled deepslate, and diamonds.
Skull Charge Banner Pattern: A skull charge banner pattern is a banner pattern used to customize banners with a shape of a skull with crossbones.
Skull Pottery Sherd: A skull pottery sherd is a pottery sherd that depicts a skeleton skull. It can be found in desert pyramids.
Sky Box: A sky box is an item added in 25w14craftmine.
Slimeball: A slimeball is a crafting ingredient commonly dropped by slimes, and can be sneezed out by pandas.
Smarter Watch: The smarter watch was an offhand item present in the April Fools' snapshot 1.RV-Pre1.
Smithing Template:
A smithing template is an item that can be applied to a tool or armor using a smithing table, which consumes the template. They are only found in structures, but diamonds can be used to craft copies.
The 18 armor trim smithing templates are used to apply customizable decorations to armor. 
Netherite upgrades are required to create netherite tools and armor.
Snort Pottery Sherd: A snort pottery sherd is a pottery sherd that depicts a sniffer. It can be found in warm ocean ruins.
Snout Armor Trim: Snout armor trim is a type of smithing template used in smithing tables to add a trim to armor. It is consumed when used, but can be duplicated using an existing template, blackstone, and diamonds.
Snout Banner Pattern: A snout banner pattern is a banner pattern used to customize banners with a shape of a piglin snout. It can only be found in bastion remnants and cannot be crafted.
Snowball: A snowball is an item obtained by breaking snow blocks or snow layers using a shovel. It can be crafted into snow blocks, thrown to knock mobs back, fed to ghastlings and used to attract happy ghasts.
Sparkler: A sparkler is a chemistry-related item that emits particles when lit. Sparklers are available in the colors orange, blue, red, purple, and green.
Spawn Egg: A spawn egg is an item used to instantly spawn mobs.
Spear: A spear is a tiered melee weapon that can be used to perform slow jab attacks or held forward to do charge attacks which deal damage based on the velocity of the user and the target. Spears have especially long reach, but cannot hit targets that are too close.
Spectral Arrow: A spectral arrow is a type of arrow that inflicts the Glowing effect on hit in addition to dealing damage.
Spider Eye: A spider eye is a food item obtained from spiders and witches that is poisonous to players, but can be safely fed to armadillos for breeding. It is also a brewing ingredient for potions of Poison, and can be fermented for further brewing uses.
Spire Armor Trim: Spire armor trim is a type of smithing template used in smithing tables to add a trim to armor. It is consumed when used, but can be duplicated using an existing template, a purpur block, and diamonds.
Splash Potion: Splash potions are a variant of potions that can be thrown.
Spyglass: A spyglass is a utility item used to zoom in on distant objects.
Steak: Steak is a food item obtained by cooking raw beef. Steak and cooked porkchops restore the most hunger out of all stackable foods.
Stick: A stick is an item used for crafting many tools and items.
Stone Axe: A stone axe is a variant of axe that is crafted from cobblestone. It can be used to cut down trees faster, to strip logs and scrape copper-based blocks, and as a melee weapon that disables shields. It is the fifth-highest tier of axe, having higher mining efficiency, attack damage, and durability than a wooden axe.
Stone Hoe: A stone hoe is a variant of hoe that is crafted from cobblestone. It is used to till dirt-related blocks into farmland, and to break leaves, haybales, and sculk-related blocks faster. It is the fifth-highest tier of hoe, having higher mining efficiency, attack speed, and durability than a wooden hoe.
Stone Pickaxe: A stone pickaxe is a variant of pickaxe that is crafted from cobblestone, blackstone, or cobbled deepslate. It is the fifth-highest tier of pickaxe, having higher mining efficiency, durability, and attack damage than a wooden pickaxe. It has a mining level of 1, allowing it to mine copper ore, iron ore, and lapis lazuli ore.
Stone Shovel: A stone shovel is a variant of shovel that is crafted from cobblestone. It is used to break dirt, sand, gravel and other related blocks faster, to create dirt paths from dirt-related blocks, and to extinguish campfires. It is the fifth-highest tier of shovel, having higher mining efficiency, attack damage, and durability than a wooden shovel.
Stone Spear: A stone spear is a variant of spear crafted from cobblestone, blackstone, or cobbled deepslate. It can be used to perform slow jab attacks or held forward to deal increasing damage based on the speed of the wielder. It is the fourth-highest tier of spear, dealing the same damage as a copper spear but with higher attack speed.
Stone Sword: A stone sword is a variant of sword crafted from cobblestone, blackstone, or cobbled deepslate. It is the fifth-highest tier of sword, dealing the same damage as a copper sword but having less durability.
String: String is an item that can be used as a crafting material or placed as tripwire to allow tripwire hooks and observers to detect entities that touch it.
Studded Armor: Studded armor refers to four armor item textures which were found in the initial versions of items.png, alongside the leather armor, chain armor and plate (iron) armor sets.
Sugar: Sugar is a food ingredient and brewing ingredient made from sugar cane or honey bottles.
Super Fertilizer: Super fertilizer is a powerful alternative to bone meal that is created using ammonia and phosphorus.
Suspicious Stew: Suspicious stew is a food item that can give the player a status effect that depends on the flower used to craft it.
Sweet Berries:
Sweet berries are a food item obtained from sweet berry bushes and are used to plant them.
Sweet berry bushes are quick-growing plants that grow sweet berries. Players and most mobs are slowed down and take constant damage while moving through them. They can be found naturally in taiga and snowy taiga biomes.
Sword: A sword is a tiered melee weapon that can be swung to deal damage, and can break blocks such as cobwebs and bamboo more quickly.
Tag (item): Tags and Bits are items exclusive to the 23w13a_or_b April Fools' joke snapshot from 2023. They are used to craft in-game representations of NBT tags.
Thing Banner Pattern: A thing banner pattern is a banner pattern used to customize banners with a shape of the old Mojang logo.
Tide Armor Trim: Tide armor trim is a type of smithing template used in smithing tables to add a trim to armor. It is consumed when used, but can be duplicated using an existing template, prismarine, and diamonds.
Tipped Arrow: A tipped arrow is a type of arrow that can inflict a status effect on hit in addition to dealing damage, depending on the potion used to create it.
Tool: A tool is an item used by the player while held to perform actions faster and more efficiently, to gather materials not obtainable by hand, or to perform completely new actions. Tools don't stack in the inventory, and can also be repaired; see Item repair.
Torchflower Seeds: Torchflower seeds are ancient seeds that have a chance to be dropped by sniffers when they finish digging. It is the seed of torchflowers.
Totem of Undying: A totem of undying is an item that can prevent players or mobs from dying when they take fatal damage. It is dropped by evokers, which spawn in woodland mansions and raids.
Toxic Beam: A toxic beam is an item dropped from toxifin slabs used to craft lashing potatoes in 24w14potato.
Toxic Resin: Toxic resin is an item used in fletching in 24w14potato.
Trial Key: A trial key is an item obtained from trial spawners and some other containers in trial chambers. It is used to unlock a standard vault and obtain its loot.
Trident: A trident is a weapon that can be used to perform melee attacks, or be thrown as a projectile that is not slowed down by water. It can rarely be obtained either from trident-wielding drowned or from trial chambers.
Tropical Fish (item): Tropical fish is a food item that cannot be cooked.
Turtle Scute: Turtle scutes are items that baby turtles drop when they grow into adults. They can be used to craft turtle shells which can be used to brew the potion of the Turtle Master.
Turtle Shell: A turtle shell is a variant of helmet that is crafted from turtle scutes. It is the third-highest tier of helmet, having the same armor points as golden, copper, iron, and chainmail helmets but with higher durability. When equipped, it grants ten seconds of Water Breathing to a player who enters water. It is also a brewing ingredient for potions of the Turtle Master.
Uncooked food: Uncooked food describes food items which can be cooked using a furnace, smoker, or campfire. They can also be found in various loot chests in naturally generated structures.
Venomous Potato: A venomous potato is a joke item added in 24w14potato.
Vex Armor Trim: Vex armor trim is a type of smithing template used in smithing tables to add a trim to armor. It is consumed when used, but can be duplicated using an existing template, cobblestone, and diamonds.
Ward Armor Trim: Ward armor trim is a type of smithing template found in ancient cities used in smithing tables to add a trim to armor. It is consumed when used, but can be duplicated using an existing template, cobbled deepslate, and diamonds.
Warped Fungus on a Stick: A warped fungus on a stick is a tool that can be used to control saddled striders.
Water Bottle:
A water bottle is a glass bottle filled with water. It can be emptied onto dirt to convert it to mud, and is a required base ingredient to brew any potion.
Splash water bottles and lingering water bottles are throwable variants obtained via brewing.
Water Bucket: A water bucket is a bucket filled with water.
Wayfinder Armor Trim: Wayfinder armor trim is a type of smithing template used in smithing tables to add a trim to armor. It is consumed when used, but can be duplicated using an existing template, terracotta, and diamonds.
Weapon: Weapons are items used to deal damage to entities. They include tools, projectiles, obstacles, and traps. Some weapons can be enchanted to enhance their combat efficacy.
Wheat: Wheat is an item primarily obtained by harvesting fully-grown wheat crops. It is used for crafting as well as to feed certain animals.
Wheat Seeds:
Wheat seeds are items obtained by breaking grass, or more abundantly harvested from wheat crops, and are used to plant them.
Wheat crops are planted in farmland and used to grow wheat and wheat seeds.
White Dye: White dye is one of the sixteen available dyes.
Wild Armor Trim: Wild armor trim is a type of smithing template used in smithing tables to add a trim to armor. It is consumed when used, but can be duplicated using an existing template, mossy cobblestone, and diamonds.
Wind Charge: A wind charge is a throwable item that bursts into wind on impact, which can knock entities into the air and interact with doors, buttons, levers, and similar blocks. A breeze rod can be crafted into 4 wind charges, and the breeze rods are obtained from breezes, which shoot out wind charges that deal half a heart of damage.
Wind Wand: A wind wand is an item introduced in 25w14craftmine. It uses the breeze rod texture with an enchantment glint. It has its other counterpart, the fire wand.
Wolf Armor: Wolf armor is an item crafted from armadillo scutes that can be equipped on a wolf to completely protect it against most damage types. It has limited durability, but can be repaired by using armadillo scutes on the wolf wearing it. It can also be dyed, and cannot be equipped on baby wolves.

It is the seventh-highest tier of axe, having the lowest mining efficiency, the lowest attack damage alongside golden axes, and having the lowest attack speed alongside stone and copper axes. It can be used as fuel in a furnace, smoker, or blast furnace.
Wooden Hoe: A wooden hoe is an early-game variant of hoe that is crafted from planks. It is used to till dirt-related blocks into farmland, and to break leaves, haybales, and sculk-related blocks faster. It is the seventh-highest tier of hoe, having the lowest mining efficiency, and having the lowest attack speed alongside golden hoes. It can be used as fuel in a furnace, smoker, or blast furnace.
Wooden Pickaxe: A wooden pickaxe is an early-game variant of pickaxe that is crafted from planks. It is the seventh-highest tier of pickaxe, having the lowest mining efficiency, and having the lowest attack damage alongside golden pickaxes. It has a mining level of 0, allowing it to mine stone and coal ore. It can be used as fuel in a furnace, smoker, or blast furnace.
Wooden Shovel: A wooden shovel is an early-game variant of shovel that is crafted from planks. It is used to break dirt, sand, gravel and other related blocks faster, to create dirt paths from dirt-related blocks, and to extinguish campfires. It is the seventh-highest tier of shovel, having the lowest mining efficiency, and having the lowest attack damage alongside golden shovels. It can be used as fuel in a furnace, smoker, or blast furnace.
Wooden Spear: A wooden spear is an early-game variant of spear crafted from planks. It can be used to perform slow jab attacks or held forward to deal increasing damage based on how quickly the wielder is moving. It is the sixth-highest tier of spear, dealing the same damage as a golden spear but with higher attack speed and durability. It can be used as fuel in a furnace, smoker, or blast furnace.
Wooden Sword: A wooden sword is an early-game variant of sword crafted from planks. It is the sixth-highest tier of sword, dealing the same damage as a golden sword but having more durability. It can be used as fuel in a furnace, smoker, or blast furnace.
Written Book: A written book is a book and quill that has been signed, which prevents its text from being edited and allows copies of it to be crafted. It can also be displayed on a lectern.
Yellow Dye: Yellow dye is one of the sixteen available dyes.
